name: db-context-engineering-dev
description: Local-dev variant. Loaded via `claude --plugin-dir`; MCP server runs from the working tree via `uv run`.

ctxset.headersHelper: bash -c 'for d in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" $(sed -n "s/.*\"installPath\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" "${HOME}/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json" 2>/dev/null) "${HOME}/.claude/plugins/cache"/*/*/* ./plugin; do [ -f "$d/scripts/adc_headers.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/scripts/adc_headers.sh"; done; exit 1'
